rationale.approved: 2026-11-02 direct user adoption: hibisk=芙. Retain the representative character of the existing name 芙蓉, with the grass radical reinforcing the plant association. Reduce the body from 20 to 7 strokes and remove the dedicated 蓉 character. 芙 remains used only by hibisk, so this is a representative-character/stroke reduction rather than increased sharing. Keep the Hibiscus-genus meaning and the existing Japanese/Chinese/Korean annotations (ハイビスカス/木槿/히비스커스), not a lotus-only or single-species meaning. Existing identifier generator yields no identifier for 芙; all other roots and identifiers unchanged. Preserve master classification content, F=3 and priority band pejvo, all root segmentation and original dictionary content. Fixed legacy plus current only; no intermediate edition or obsolete aliases. Other candidates remain review-only.

migration_notice: Only current hibisk changes. Other owners and fixed legacy assignments stay unchanged. No old-spelling aliases or intermediate editions.
